locationArchetypes.Show Comes to Town:
Atmosphere:
- painted wagons and a tent on the town's one flat field
- music and woodsmoke at the edge of town after dark
- the whole town watching the show folk out of the corner of its eye

Tensions:
- the mayor wants them gone and the kids want them to stay
- every missing chicken gets blamed on the show
- a rival show working the same road a day behind

Patterns:
- the town comes to look on the first night and to pay on the second
- trouble at the camp gets settled before the constable turns up
- the show leaves owing nobody, or it doesn't leave at all

Secrets:
- someone in town paid to have the show run off
- one of the acts grew up here and left for a reason
- the takings are short and somebody in the troupe knows why
